name: Bedford Park Playground
text: Birkdale's largest park which features sport and play areas. On Sefton Council's park finder: Bedford Road, Birkdale, PR8 4HT.

name: Duke Street Park Playground
text: Popular park in Formby with large play area, tennis courts, bowling greens and football pitches. On Sefton Council's park finder: Duke Street, Formby, L37 4AN.

name: Marian Gardens Playground
text: Netherton's largest park with play areas, open spaces and sports areas. On Sefton Council's park finder: Bridge Lane, Netherton, L30 3SW.

name: Meols Park Playground
text: A large open space at the gateway to Southport featuring a play area and football pitches. On Sefton Council's park finder: Scarisbrick New Road, Southport, PR8 5HL.

name: Victoria Park Playground
text: A large multi use facility in the centre of Waterloo with sport and play facilities as well as lovely features. On Sefton Council's park finder: College Road, Waterloo, L22 2AP.

name: Abbeyfield Park Playground
text: Park with numerous facilities including play area and basketball area. On Sefton Council's park finder: Park Lane, Netherton, L30 1PF.

name: Copy Farm Park Playground
text: A small park on the site of a former farm which features a small woodland and play area. On Sefton Council's park finder: Hollinhey Close, Netherton, L30 7RN.

name: Coronation Park Playground
text: Lovely park in the heart of Crosby featuring play area, tennis courts and a model boating lake. On Sefton Council's park finder: Coronation Road, Crosby, L23 5RD.

name: Deerbarn Park Playground
text: A small neighbourhood park situated next to the play area at Ollery Green. On Sefton Council's park finder: Deerbarn Park, Deerbarn Drive L30 8SA.

name: Kirkstone Road Park Playground
text: Open park in Litherland with a popular play area. On Sefton Council's park finder: Kirkstone Road, Litherland, L21 7NP.

name: Moorside Park Playground
text: A large park in the heart of Crosby with a good sized play area and other features. On Sefton Council's park finder: Moorside Road, Crosby, L23 2RS.

name: Sandbrook Road Recreation Ground Playground
text: Ainsdale sporting park with play area and multi use sports area. On Sefton Council's park finder: Sandbrook Road, Ainsdale, PR8 3RQ.

name: Smithy Green Playground
text: This open space has a medium play area and football areas. On Sefton Council's park finder: Moss Side, Formby, L37 3JZ.

name: Bootle Golf Course Playground
text: This municipal course is open to all and playing contracts are available. On Sefton Council's park finder: Dunningsbridge Road, Litherland, L30 2PP.
